name: Paul Tol Vibrant
summary: Seven high-energy colors from Paul Tol's Vibrant scheme: orange, blue, cyan, magenta, red, teal and grey.
guidance: Vibrant is the most saturated of Paul Tol's schemes and was made to stay distinguishable for color blindness.
Magenta (accent) and red (danger) are close in hue, so keep them apart by role: accent for emphasis, danger only for errors, and always with an icon.
Built for color-blind accessibility: the hues stay distinguishable for the most common types of color blindness, mainly by differing in lightness as well as hue.
Several of these colors are too light to carry white text. Put dark text (ink) on them, as the contrast checks below show, and never white text.
Body text needs 4.5:1 against its background; large text and UI outlines need 3:1.
Still pair every status color with an icon or text. Color alone should never be the only signal.

credit.text: Paul Tol, Colour Schemes, SRON technical note SRON/EPS/TN/09-002. The hex values are the published Vibrant scheme.
